# hyperfluid_agent (Data Source)

Look up a Sapience AI agent by name within an environment, e.g. the routing agent a capability answers for.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_environment" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

data "hyperfluid_agent" "this" {
  env  = data.hyperfluid_environment.default.id
  name = "support"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `env` (String) Environment id.
- `name` (String) Agent name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `id` (String) Agent id.
- `interfaces` (Set of String) Where the agent is reachable.
- `mail_address` (String) Address the agent is reachable at by mail.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase.
- `slug` (String) Derived slug, which a capability's `subagent_of` names.
- `speciality` (String) What the agent is for.
- `subagent_of` (String) Slug of the routing agent it answers for, if it is a capability.
